scenes.title: My amazing weekend

lines.en: Hi, Lucy! How was your weekend?
lines.zh: 你好，露西！你周末过得怎么样？

lines.en: It was great! I climbed the Great Wall.
lines.zh: 太棒了！我爬了长城。

lines.en: Wow! The Great Wall is amazing.
lines.zh: 哇！长城真了不起。

lines.en: What did you do, Mia?
lines.zh: 米娅，你做了什么？

lines.en: I walked around the Palace Museum with Pip.
lines.zh: 我和皮皮在故宫里转了转。

lines.en: It was so big! I took a lot of photos.
lines.zh: 它好大呀！我拍了好多照片。

lines.en: Can I see them?
lines.zh: 我能看看吗？

lines.en: Sure! Look, here they are.
lines.zh: 当然！看，就是这些。

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Lucy climbed the Great Wall. How was your weekend?

scenes.title: Happy Spring Festival
patterns: Did you ...? Yes, we did. / No, we didn't.

lines.en: How was your Spring Festival holiday, Mia?
lines.zh: 米娅，你的春节假期过得怎么样？

lines.en: It was great! My family and I got together.
lines.zh: 好极了！我们一家人团聚了。

lines.en: What did you do?
lines.zh: 你们做了什么？

lines.en: We cleaned the house and pasted fu on the door.
lines.zh: 我们打扫了房子，还在门上贴了福字。

lines.en: I helped! And I dressed in red too.
lines.zh: 我也帮忙了！我还穿了红色的衣服。

lines.en: Did you eat jiaozi?
lines.zh: 你们吃饺子了吗？

lines.en: Yes, we did. Then we counted down to the new year.
lines.zh: 吃了。然后我们一起倒数迎接新年。

lines.en: Three, two, one! Happy New Year!
lines.zh: 三、二、一！新年快乐！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. I love the Spring Festival! What did you do for the Spring Festival?

scenes.title: Get well soon, Lucy!
patterns: I feel ill. My head hurts.
I have a bad cold / a runny nose.

lines.en: Hi, Lucy. Are you going to the science museum tomorrow?
lines.zh: 嗨，露西。你明天去科技馆吗？

lines.en: I'm afraid not. I have a bad cold.
lines.zh: 恐怕去不了。我得了重感冒。

lines.en: Oh dear! How do you feel?
lines.zh: 哎呀！你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: I feel ill. My head hurts and I have a runny nose.
lines.zh: 我不舒服。我头疼，还流鼻涕。

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. You should drink some water.
lines.zh: 听到这个我很难过。你应该多喝点水。

lines.en: Maybe you should see a doctor too.
lines.zh: 也许你还应该去看看医生。

lines.en: Thanks. I'm going to have a good rest.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我要好好休息一下。

lines.en: Don't stay up late. Get well soon!
lines.zh: 别熬夜哦。早日康复！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Lucy has a bad cold. How do you feel today?

scenes.title: Lucy's pocket money
patterns: How are you going to spend it?
I'm going to save up for ...
We can wait for a sale.

lines.en: Look, Mia! Grandpa gave me some pocket money.
lines.zh: 看，米娅！爷爷给了我一些零花钱。

lines.en: How are you going to spend it?
lines.zh: 你打算怎么花它？

lines.en: I'm going to buy a new schoolbag.
lines.zh: 我打算买一个新书包。

lines.en: Good idea! But you can wait for a sale.
lines.zh: 好主意！不过你可以等打折的时候再买。

lines.en: I'm going to save up for a robot.
lines.zh: 我打算攒钱买一个机器人。

lines.en: Let's write a spending plan together!
lines.zh: 我们一起写个消费计划吧！

lines.en: Yes! Buy what you need first, then what you want.
lines.zh: 对！先买需要的，再买想要的。

lines.en: That's a smart way to use money!
lines.zh: 这是用钱的聪明办法！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Lucy got some pocket money. How are you going to spend your pocket money?

scenes.title: Stars over the roof
patterns: What can you see in the sky?
Is there any water on Mars?

lines.en: Look up! What can you see in the sky?
lines.zh: 抬头看！你们能在天上看到什么？

lines.en: I can see the Moon and lots of stars.
lines.zh: 我能看到月亮和好多星星。

lines.en: What's that red star?
lines.zh: 那颗红色的星星是什么？

lines.en: It's not a star. It's Mars, a planet.
lines.zh: 它不是星星。它是火星，一颗行星。

lines.en: Is there any water on Mars?
lines.zh: 火星上有水吗？

lines.en: There is some ice. But there aren't any living things.
lines.zh: 有一些冰。但是没有任何生物。

lines.en: I want to be an astronaut one day.
lines.zh: 我想有一天当宇航员。

lines.en: Me too! We can travel to space in a spaceship!
lines.zh: 我也是！我们可以坐宇宙飞船去太空！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Let's look at the sky! What can you see in the sky at night?

scenes.title: Let's save energy!
patterns: Small changes can make a big difference.

lines.en: It's so hot! Let's turn on the air conditioner.
lines.zh: 好热啊！我们开空调吧。

lines.en: Wait! We should use air conditioners less.
lines.zh: 等等！我们应该少用空调。

lines.en: Why, Pip?
lines.zh: 为什么呢，皮皮？

lines.en: Many resources are running out. Solar power and wind power are green energy.
lines.zh: 很多资源快用完了。太阳能和风能是绿色能源。

lines.en: How can we save energy?
lines.zh: 我们怎样节约能源呢？

lines.en: We can turn off the lights in the daytime.
lines.zh: 白天我们可以把灯关掉。

lines.en: And we can reuse bottles and recycle boxes.
lines.zh: 我们还可以重复使用瓶子，回收纸箱。

lines.en: Small changes can make a big difference!
lines.zh: 小小的改变能带来大大的不同！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Let's save energy! What can you do to save energy at home?

scenes.title: New friends at winter camp
patterns: Did you make any new friends?
We played games and shared jokes.

lines.en: Lucy, did you make any new friends at the winter camp?
lines.zh: 露西，你在冬令营交到新朋友了吗？

lines.en: Yes! I made two new friends.
lines.zh: 交到了！我交了两个新朋友。

lines.en: Where are they from?
lines.zh: 他们是哪里人？

lines.en: Ivan is from Russia. He speaks Russian.
lines.zh: 伊万来自俄罗斯。他说俄语。

lines.en: Akiko is from Japan. She speaks Japanese.
lines.zh: 明子来自日本。她说日语。

lines.en: How did you talk with them?
lines.zh: 你是怎么和他们交流的？

lines.en: We played games and shared jokes.
lines.zh: 我们一起玩游戏，讲笑话。

lines.en: Smiling is a world language!
lines.zh: 微笑是世界通用的语言！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Lucy made new friends. Did you make any new friends this year?

scenes.title: A trip to Dunhuang
patterns: Where did you go during the holiday?
How can we learn about our traditions?

lines.en: Where did you go during the holiday, Mia?
lines.zh: 米娅，你假期去哪儿了？

lines.en: I went to Dunhuang and visited the Mogao Caves.
lines.zh: 我去了敦煌，参观了莫高窟。

lines.en: Wow! What did you see there?
lines.zh: 哇！你在那里看到了什么？

lines.en: I saw many beautiful wall paintings.
lines.zh: 我看到了很多漂亮的壁画。

lines.en: Dunhuang was an important stop on the Silk Road.
lines.zh: 敦煌曾经是丝绸之路上重要的一站。

lines.en: How can we learn about our traditions?
lines.zh: 我们怎样了解我们的传统呢？

lines.en: We can listen to folk songs and read old stories.
lines.zh: 我们可以听民歌，读古老的故事。

lines.en: And I'll show you more photos tomorrow!
lines.zh: 明天我再给你们看更多照片！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Mia went to Dunhuang. Where did you go during the holiday?

scenes.title: Then and now
patterns: I'm as tall as you now!

lines.en: Lucy, look at this old photo!
lines.zh: 露西，看这张老照片！

lines.en: Is that you? You were so small!
lines.zh: 这是你吗？你那时好小啊！

lines.en: Yes. I was a lot shorter than you then.
lines.zh: 是的。那时我比你矮多了。

lines.en: How tall are you now, Mia?
lines.zh: 米娅，你现在多高？

lines.en: I'm 1.55 metres.
lines.zh: 我一米五五。

lines.en: Now you're as tall as me!
lines.zh: 现在你和我一样高了！

lines.en: And I'm better at English now.
lines.zh: 而且我现在英语也更好了。

lines.en: You're both taller and smarter than before!
lines.zh: 你们俩都比以前更高、更聪明了！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Mia is as tall as Lucy now! How tall are you?

scenes.title: Great inventions
patterns: What important inventions do you know about?

lines.en: What important inventions do you know about?
lines.zh: 你们知道哪些重要的发明？

lines.en: Paper! We use paper to write and draw.
lines.zh: 纸！我们用纸来写字和画画。

lines.en: And the compass. We use a compass to find the way.
lines.zh: 还有指南针。我们用指南针找路。

lines.en: Before the bulb, many people used candles.
lines.zh: 在有灯泡以前，很多人用蜡烛。

lines.en: I can't imagine the world without bulbs.
lines.zh: 我无法想象没有灯泡的世界。

lines.en: What will we invent in the future?
lines.zh: 将来我们会发明什么？

lines.en: I think we'll invent a time machine!
lines.zh: 我觉得我们会发明时光机！

lines.en: Then let's visit the past together!
lines.zh: 那我们就一起去过去看看吧！

scenes.ask: Hi! I'm Pip. Let's talk about inventions! What important inventions do you know about?
